name: SH2 Cast - Left (self)
description: MSCO's Base - Self Left art on the neutral MSCO_left1-4 path names, for a fire-and-forget SELF cast resolved to the LEFT hand. SpellHotbar_SpellAnimationType (0x815) == 2 is kSelf.primary; SpellHotbar_CastingSource (0x835) == 0 is the left hand. MSCO's self-left set repeats one clip across slots 1, 3 and 4 (only slot 2 is distinct art), so per-file stamps keep every clip byte-unique (ADR-0017). The clips keep MSCO's MLh_SpellFire_Event and its MLh_Equipped_Event.
